technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Cloud Stream (s-c-s) framework as the target repo for porting modules.
Implement each ported module as a Spring Boot auto-configuration component (sink or source) following s-c-s binder conventions.
Use Java 17+ as required by Spring Framework 6.0.
Leverage existing Spring XD module source code as reference to ensure feature parity.
Use Maven/Gradle for build and dependency management, with unit and integration tests using JUnit and Testcontainers where needed.
For HDFS updates, update Hadoop dependency versions to support HDP/PHD distros and adjust configuration accordingly.
Migration documentation will be written in Markdown and included in the repository's documentation section.
assumptions: The target s-c-s repository already exists with basic project structure and CI pipeline.
Access to the original Spring XD module source code is available for reference.
Each module port is independent and can be developed and tested in isolation.
Integration tests may require external services (FTP, Rabbit, Redis, Gemfire, HDFS) but testcontainers or local instances will be used.
The developer has sufficient knowledge of Spring XD and Spring Cloud Stream to perform the porting.
No major architectural changes are required beyond adapting the modules to s-c-s patterns.
Effort estimates assume a single developer working full-time on these tasks.
U7 (HDP/PHD) is limited to updating dependencies and verifying compatibility; no new features are required.
U8 (migration documentation) is a standalone writing task based on existing release notes and changes.

Analyze existing Spring XD redis module, implement as a sink in s-c-s, with tests and build updates.
Analyze existing Spring XD rabbit module, implement as a source in s-c-s, with tests and build updates (rabbit as source requires different binding configuration).
Analyze existing Spring XD gemfire module, implement as a sink in s-c-s, including GemFire client integration, tests, and build updates.
